description: This file defines the 'Tracing' class, which manages tracing operations such as starting, stopping, grouping, and collecting stack traces within the Playwright core library. It interacts with external modules like 'artifact' and 'channelOwner', and implements the 'api.Tracing' interface.

classes.name: Tracing
classes.description: A class that manages tracing sessions, including starting, stopping, grouping, and collecting stack traces, with support for live tracing and artifact management.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a Tracing instance from a given channel.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new Tracing object with parent, type, guid, and initializer.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a tracing session with optional parameters like name, title, snapshots, screenshots, sources, and live mode.

methods.name: startChunk
methods.description: Starts a new trace chunk with optional name and title.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Creates a new tracing group, optionally with a source code location.

methods.name: _startCollectingStacks
methods.description: Begins collecting stack traces, setting internal state and retrieving stack IDs.

methods.name: stopChunk
methods.description: Stops the current trace chunk, optionally saving to a specified file path.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the tracing session and the current chunk, optionally saving to a file.

methods.name: _doStopChunk
methods.description: Handles stopping a trace chunk, saving artifacts, and zipping trace data.

methods.name: _resetStackCounter
methods.description: Resets tracing state and updates connection flags.
